messages:
deploybot: PRELAUNCH CHECK: prompt_suite_multilingual v3.2 — gating check failed on canary.

alex: ack. which metric triggered the gate?

maya: summary_coherence increased (worse) on fr and de slices. aggregate +4% vs baseline. also long-fr rouge_l down ~1.1%. commit range points to recent quant tweak.

jamie: can you paste the specific failing slices? need to decide scope (full rollback vs regional pin).

maya: ```
FAILED SLICES:
- fr: summary_coherence baseline 0.86 -> 0.824 (-4.2%)
- de: summary_coherence baseline 0.88 -> 0.844 (-3.9%)
- fr-long: rouge_l 0.41 -> 0.405 (-1.2%)
commit: 8f9a3b2
config: per-token quant jitter enabled
```

taylor: are these customer-facing features? EU digest relies on multilingual summarization.

alex: two paths: (1) full global rollback to v2.9.0, quick and safe; (2) regional pin for EU while we hotfix. prefer (2) if product/regional routing is fast.

jamie: deploy tooling supports region overrides. I can bisect to the suspect commit and confirm causality.

maya: I'll reproduce the failing slices locally with a 10k focused eval.

alex: actions:
- jamie: bisect commit range, report in 20m
- maya: reproduce + 10k eval, post diffs in 30m
- taylor: prepare customer comms for EU temporary routing
- ops-bot: pre-generate route_override ready to apply

jamie: starting bisect now.

deploybot: Canary held: no auto-promote until manual decision.

ops-bot: route_override template ready:
```
route_override {
  regions: ["eu-west1","eu-central1"]
  model: "redwood-model-v2.9.0"
}
```

maya: repro confirms delta when quant jitter on; disabling jitter restores parity on fr/de slices.

jamie: bisect pins primary suspect to 8f9a3b2 (quant jitter enable). secondary tweak 8f9a3c9 less likely.

alex: propose: apply EU pin to v2.9.0 now, create hotfix branch removing jitter, run eval/CI. If hotfix passes, re-promote EU to v2.9.1.

maya: +1. will run full suite once hotfix CI passes.

taylor: +1 from product. drafting ETA note for affected customers.

jamie: hotfix branch created: hotfix/disable-quant-jitter, CI queued.

ops-bot: ready to apply route override when @alex approves.

alex: manual approve for EU pin. @ops-bot apply route_override now. keep canary held for other regions.

ops-bot: Applying override... done. eu-west1 & eu-central1 pinned to redwood-model-v2.9.0 :white_check_mark:

taylor: comms sent to SRE/customer-ops with note + expected timeline. will post to status page on request.

jamie: CI green for hotfix. maya running 10k focused eval now.

maya: hotfix reduces fr/de deltas into noise band (+0.2% / -0.1%). running full regression sweep.

alex: recording decision: partial EU rollback (pin), hotfix created to disable quant jitter, release window for EU delayed until verification. Audit logged.

deploybot: release audit recorded action_id=rb-2104001234-01 initiated_by=alex

maya: full suite looks green on hotfix branch.

ops-bot: prepared to flip EU back to v2.9.1 on manual confirm.

alex: reviewed full suite. approve re-promotion for EU in next change window (in ~90m). ops-bot, schedule promotion.

ops-bot: scheduled EU promotion to v2.9.1 at window start. manual lock remains until promotion completes.

jamie: will follow up with a short post-deploy smoke check and then close the canary hold.

deploybot: thread archived for continuity. keep any follow-ups here. :lock:
